name: AgizoAI Publisher – AI Content & SEO Writer
author: N-Ramdharry

sections.description:
AgizoAI Publisher is an AI-assisted editorial plugin for WordPress. It helps site owners create draft articles, SEO titles, meta descriptions, secondary keyphrases, tutorials, research-based posts, internal links and optional featured images from inside the WordPress dashboard.

The plugin supports multiple AI providers, including OpenAI, Claude / Anthropic, Google Gemini and custom OpenAI-compatible APIs. Users provide their own API keys. Generated content is saved as drafts or pending-review posts so editors can review before publishing.

AgizoAI Publisher is designed for editorial workflows, SEO preparation, research queues, tutorials and content planning. It does not guarantee rankings, traffic or compliance. Users remain responsible for reviewing all generated content before publication.

Core features:

  • Setup Wizard for fast configuration.
  • Multi-AI provider support for OpenAI, Claude / Anthropic, Google Gemini and custom OpenAI-compatible APIs.
  • Manual AI article generation.
  • Research Mode from trusted RSS sources.
  • Professional journalist writing mode.
  • True Tutorial Article mode.
  • Per-article tone and rewrite controls.
  • SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase and secondary keyphrases.
  • SEO meta compatibility layer and custom SEO meta key mapping.
  • Existing post SEO tools for posts, pages and public custom post types.
  • Optional WEBP featured image generation.
  • Internal linking, related articles and schema options.
  • Generated Articles history and Content Calendar.
  • Built-in documentation inside WordPress.

Plugin page: https://www.agizoai.com/agizoai-publisher-wordpress-plugin

External Services

This plugin connects to external services only when the site administrator configures and uses those features. The plugin does not create accounts with these services. Administrators must provide their own API keys or feed URLs.

OpenAI

OpenAI may be used for API key verification, article generation, rewrites, SEO metadata generation and optional WEBP image generation when OpenAI is selected or image generation is enabled. The plugin may send prompts, article topics, selected post content, excerpts, research notes, SEO instructions, image prompts and selected plugin settings needed for generation.

Service endpoint examples used by the plugin include api.openai.com for models, responses and image generation.
Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Anthropic / Claude

Anthropic Claude may be used for API key verification, article generation, rewrites and SEO metadata generation when Claude is selected as the text AI provider. The plugin may send prompts, article topics, selected post content, excerpts, research notes, SEO instructions and selected plugin settings needed for generation.

Service endpoint used by the plugin: https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages
Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms
Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

Google Gemini

Google Gemini may be used for API key verification, article generation, rewrites and SEO metadata generation when Gemini is selected as the text AI provider. The plugin may send prompts, article topics, selected post content, excerpts, research notes, SEO instructions and selected plugin settings needed for generation.

Service endpoint used by the plugin: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/
Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Custom OpenAI-compatible API

A custom OpenAI-compatible API may be used only when the administrator enters a custom endpoint and API key. The plugin sends the same types of generation data listed above to the configured endpoint. The administrator is responsible for checking the terms and privacy policy of the configured custom service.

RSS feeds

Research Mode requests RSS feed URLs only when the administrator adds a source and clicks fetch, or when the administrator enables automatic RSS fetching. The plugin requests the feed URL and stores imported item titles, links, dates and summaries in the WordPress database for the research queue. The terms and privacy policy depend on each feed URL added by the administrator.

External AI consent

The settings screen includes a consent checkbox. API verification, AI text generation and AI image generation are blocked until the administrator confirms that selected prompts, post content, research notes, metadata and verification requests may be sent to the chosen external AI provider.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate AgizoAI Publisher.
  3. Open AgizoAI Publisher > Setup Wizard.
  4. Choose a text AI provider and add the matching API key.
  5. Verify the selected AI provider from Settings.
  6. Generate one draft article and review it before publishing.
sections.faq:
Does it publish automatically?

The default workflow is draft-first. Review generated content before publishing.

Can it optimise existing posts?

Yes. AgizoAI Publisher > SEO Tools can generate SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase, secondary keyphrases and image metadata for existing posts, pages and public custom post types.

Can I use my own SEO plugin fields?

Yes. Settings include custom SEO meta key mapping for title, description, focus keyphrase, secondary keyphrases, canonical URL and robots values.

Does it generate WEBP images?

Yes, when image generation is enabled and a compatible image API is configured.

Is human review recommended?

Yes. AI-generated articles should be reviewed before publication, especially for sensitive or factual topics.
